name: Green-Flame Blade
description: Make a melee weapon attack; on a hit, green fire leaps from the target to a second creature within 5 feet of it, dealing fire damage.
dmg roll: weapon damage; secondary target takes fire equal to spellcasting modifier
higher_spellslot_benefit: At 5th, 11th, and 17th level: +1d8, +2d8, +3d8 fire on the hit target, and the secondary target takes 1d8, 2d8, 3d8 + spellcasting modifier.
